primary.poolable_reason: THE PUBLISHED VALUES APPEAR IN NEITHER TRIAL'S SOURCE RECORD, AND THE ARMS PAIRED TO PRODUCE THEM ARE A COMPARISON NEITHER TRIAL PERFORMED. BOTH TRIALS ARE FOUR-ARM 2x2 DESIGNS of dosing frequency, and each registers TWO treatment comparisons, both WITHIN a frequency. BERSON registers Placebo Q2W against Evolocumab Q2W, -70.29 (-75.43 to -65.16), and Placebo QM against Evolocumab QM, -70.04 (-74.67 to -65.41). Hua Tuo registers Placebo Q2W against Evolocumab 140 mg Q2W, -70.73 (-77.98 to -63.48), and Placebo QM against Evolocumab 420 mg QM, -69.74 (-76.51 to -62.97). THIS OBJECT CROSSES THE FREQUENCIES ON BOTH TRIALS: it pairs BERSON's placebo Q2W arm with its MONTHLY evolocumab arm, and Hua Tuo's placebo Q2W arm with its MONTHLY 420 mg arm. Neither cross-pairing was registered, analysed or reported by anyone. AND THE STORED VALUES MATCH NOTHING. BERSON is held here as -71.8 (-81.39 to -62.21) against registered values of -70.29 and -70.04; Hua Tuo as -70.8 (-80.57 to -61.03) against -70.73 and -69.74. Neither stored value is either registered comparison, and neither is the difference between ANY two of the four arm means each trial reports. The stored intervals are roughly half again as wide as the registered ones. SEPARATELY: THE ARM ROLES ARE INVERTED ON BOTH TRIALS. The arm carrying role TREATMENT is the placebo arm on Hua Tuo ('Placebo Q2W') and the statin-only arm on BERSON ('Atorvastatin (Q2W)'), while the evolocumab arm carries role CONTROL on both. This is the fourth object in which that inversion has been found and the first in which the arms were ALSO cross-paired.

pooled.withdrawn_note: WHAT THIS WITHDRAWAL IS NOT, STATED AS PROMINENTLY AS WHAT IT IS. IT IS ABOUT PROVENANCE, NOT ABOUT WHETHER EVOLOCUMAB LOWERS LDL-C. The registry corroborates the direction and very nearly the magnitude: ALL FOUR registered comparisons across the two trials lie between -69.74 and -70.73 per cent, and the withdrawn pooled value was -71.31. The finding that evolocumab lowers LDL-C by about seventy percentage points more than placebo on top of a statin IS AMPLY SUPPORTED BY THE SOURCE RECORDS. What cannot stand is THESE NUMBERS: a pooled estimate assembled from two per-trial values that appear in no source document, over arm pairings neither trial analysed. A reader who checks us against the registry finds our conclusion and not our arithmetic, and the whole claim of this project is that those two should be the same thing. WHAT IS CONFIRMED. (1) THE ESTIMAND AGREES: both registrations name percent change from baseline in LDL-C at the MEAN OF WEEKS 10 AND 12, the same quantity over the same window, and both analyse it as a least-squares mean from a repeated-measures linear model. (2) Both trials also register a WEEK 12 co-primary that this review does not use -- on either trial, so the omission is uniform. (3) Identity by registration is correct on both: NCT02662569 is BERSON and NCT03433755 is the Chinese primary-hypercholesterolaemia study, and both registrations' arm lists match the labels this object carries, which is how the cross-pairing was detectable at all. THE REPLACEMENT QUESTION IS IDENTIFIED AND DELIBERATELY NOT TAKEN. Each trial registers TWO comparisons and a synthesis must choose: the Q2W pair, the QM pair, both with a shared control, or an average. That is an estimand choice, all four answers are now known to whoever would choose it, and the rule that parked ABLATION_AF, SGLT2_CKD, DOAC_AF and DOAC_CANCER_VTE applies unchanged. PARKED.

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In adults with mixed dyslipidemia, does Evolocumab compared with placebo affect the outcome each trial registered as its primary, which differ across the 2 trials here?

It examines 2 randomised trials and DOES NOT POOL THEM, against not recorded on the page this object was extracted from.

The outcome sought is Multiple trial-declared outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline in LDL-C at the Mean of Weeks 10 and 12 | Co-Primary Endpoint: Percent Change From Baseline in LDL-C: Mean of Weeks 10 and 12.
